title: The first one
text: Just like this first letter, I still remember the first time I saw you, our first shifts together at Wilsons, and similarly. I remember our first everything, those first kisses that I always find myself back at, feeling those moments where we intertwined our lives. from our first dinner dates together to our very last ones. I only want it too be you. I am so happy that this world has decided we should meet, you have taught me things that I dont think I could ever have learnt without you, and while some of those lessons needed to be extremely hard, I think that we went through what we did to become the people we are today, I know that I might not have been the man I am now without those hard lessons, and without you. for that, I love you, I love you today, I love you tomorrow, I love you forever and always.

title: On ordinary days
text: One of my favourite things is how ordinary moments with you feels like the best parts of life, you are able to make the most normal of moments, into ones that forever become my most adored memories, whether its looking out a window at cars going by, or the ghost in the School, whether it is listining to music and drinking cocktails while we prepare for a night out, or argue over who's night it is to choose the movie. those moments are wonds that I hold so deearly close to my heart, and ones that I wont ever forget. I adore you Kayla, inside and out.

title: Just because
text: I just wanted you to know I’m thinking of you, from the first song of the birds in the morning, to the last light in the dark of night, you remain on my mind for the distance between.

title: No Distance Could Make Me Choose Anyone Else
text:
My Love,

I wish that I could make you feel, without ever having to question it, just how certain I am aabout you and how little the distance between us changes the way I feel. 

There is nobody who I am looking for. There is nobody who I'm comparing you to. There isn't someone waiting around the corner who could suddenly become more important to me. The truth is, I don't look at other people and wonder what it would be like if they were you. I don't find myself searching for something that I feel is missing, because my heart already knows who it wants. 

I know distance makes things difficult. There are days when I wish I could reach across the space between us, and pull you into my arms and remind you that everything is okay. Moments when I'd give anything to have the simplest things with you, as small as hearing a song you have been listening too, and hearing your voice with my own ears. Being able to take your hand in mine and locking our fingers. 

Love is not something I only feel when you are within reach, and it wont simply disappear because I can't kiss you, it doesn't become less real because of the kilometers between us. When days feel long, when you miss me or when you need to be reassured, I hope you remember this letter. 

I'm not waiting for someone else. I'm not hoping to find a replacement. I'm not keeping my options open while asking you to believe in us. 

I know who I want. 

I want the person who I wish I could wake up to every morning. The person I want to tell about the most insignificant things that happened throughout the day. The person I want to make memories with, laugh with and grow with. 

I want you. 

And if it takes time before life allows us to have the togetherness we both wish for, then I want you to know that the waiting doesn't ever change the person I want at the end of it. 

Until the distance is no longer something we have to think about, until the day I can hold you, until all the little moments we've been missing become moments we finally get to share, please know that my heart isn't looking elsewhere. 

It's right where I want it to be, WIth you. 

I love you Kayla 

It's you. It will always be you that I want to find my way back to.
